name: dumbbell side plank v. 2
description: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.
